messages.text:
I turned on reduced motion on my computer, but the cards and the win banner still animate. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and the other documents in docs/ for this project's requirements.

Fixed reduced motion for cards and the win banner. When the system requests reduced motion, card border changes are immediate and the banner appears without a pulse. Normal motion remains unchanged.

The build and type check passed, as did all 138 unit and static tests. The browser suite passed 74 of 76 checks, including both motion checks; two unrelated artwork and score-persistence checks timed out, including on individual reruns.

The changed files pass formatting. The repository-wide formatting check reports issues in 13 unrelated files.
